faq.title: Questions healthcare visitors may ask first.

q1.question: What is SafeLab?
q1.answer: SafeLab is a B2B SaaS platform for automated environmental monitoring, preventive alerts and traceability in laboratories, hospitals and pharmacy networks.

q2.question: Who is the solution designed for?
q2.answer: It is designed for laboratory coordinators, pharmacy technicians, quality managers and healthcare institutions responsible for sensitive biological inventory.

q3.question: Does the platform help with audits and compliance?
q3.answer: Yes. SafeLab is intended to support audit processes through automated reporting and persistent historical records that improve traceability.
